subject: general
question: In February 2022, the Sports Authority of India (SAI) established a Para Centre under the National Centre of Excellence (NCOE) Scheme at which of the following SAI Regional Centres?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhinagar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Vijay Goel** declared **Netaji Subhas western regional center of the Sports Authority of India (SAI) in Gandhinagar **as a Centre of Excellence for para-athletics.
 
• It is the **first ever training center dedicated to Para athletes in the country.**
 
• In this **Centre ****Para athletes will be trained for various International Competitions including Asian Games, Common Wealth Games, and Olympic Games.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The **Sports Science Centre, Directorate of Sports and Youth Welfare (DSYW), **in **Bhopal** caters to all the Elite Sports Academies run by the Sports and Youth Welfare Department, Government of M.P.
